tasks: place the square building blocks in the center with left hand and put the cylindrical building blocks on top with right hand.

generation_prompt: The robot's left hand pinches the blue lettered cube between its thumb and fingers, lifts it, sets it on top of the yellow cube, then opens and withdraws to the left. Afterward the right hand reaches in, closes its fingers around the green numbered cube, lifts it, carries it left, and lowers it onto the blue cube, then lets go and rises away while the left hand stays idle. The result is a three-cube stack of yellow, blue and green, the green cube slightly turned. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
data_quality_gate.exception_reason: Dataset-wide exception (2026-10-15), granted after visual review of the first episodes: edges of the hands and blocks were judged acceptable; the low score is driven mostly by the large untextured table.
